items.title: Control of Heartbeat (Heart Excitation and Contraction) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Control of Heartbeat (Heart Excitation and Contraction): a main subheading of 11.1 Structure and functioning of the heart, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 239-240.

blocks.text: Dil ki pumping Sinoatrial Node (SA node) shuru karta hai, jise pacemaker bhi kehte hain. SA node cardiac muscle cells ka ek chhota guchha (cluster) hai. Yeh daen atrium ki oopar wali deewar mein dhansa hua hai. Dharkan tab shuru hoti hai jab SA node atria ki deewaron ko electrical impulses (barqi ishare) bhejta hai. Is se dono atria ek saath sukarte hain. Phir yeh impulses atrioventricular node (AV node) tak jate hain. AV node bhi cardiac muscle cells ka chhota guchha hai aur interatrial septum ke nichle hisse mein hota hai.

AV node se impulses atrioventricular bundle (AV bundle), jise bundle of His bhi kehte hain, tak pohanchte hain. Yeh interventricular septum mein fibres (reshon) ka jaal hai. AV bundle baen aur daen shakhon (branches) mein bat jata hai, jo ventricles ki deewaron mein Purkinje fibres par khatam hoti hain. In fibres tak impulse pohanchne se dono ventricles taqreeban ek saath sukarte hain (Figure 11.4). SA node se AV node tak impulse pohanchne mein taqreeban 0.15 second ki der (delay) hoti hai; is der ki wajah se atrial systole poori ho jati hai aur us ke baad ventricular systole shuru hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Kata hua dil aur us ka conducting nizam: right atrium ki oopri deewar mein SA node impulses ko atrial septum ke nichle sire par AV node tak bhejta hai; wahan se AV bundle septum mein neeche jata hai aur right branch aur left branch mein batta hai, jo ventricles ki deewaron mein Purkinje fibres ban kar phailti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.4: Pacemaker aur us ke rabte (textbook ki Figure 11.4 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: SA node, AV node, Right branch of AV bundle, Left branch of AV bundle, Purkinje fibres.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Raasta: SA node (pacemaker) -> AV node (thora ruk kar atria ko pehle sukarne deta hai) -> AV bundle -> right aur left branches -> Purkinje fibres -> ventricles neeche se oopar sukarte hain.

Agar electrical impulses ke raste mein koi rukawat (block) ho, ya SA node ke impulses kamzor hon, to dharkan ki baqaidgi (rhythm) mein der ho sakti hai ya dharkan ruk bhi sakti hai. SA node kamzor ho to aise mareezon mein artificial pacemaker lagaya jata hai. Yeh battery se chalne wala aala (device) hai jo operation (surgery) se AV node ke qareeb lagaya jata hai. Yeh electrical signals bhejta hai jin se dil mamool ke mutabiq dharakta hai.
